ValidationRule.description: Helps guide and remind the user that PO Documents must be uploaded prior to Closed Won status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( PO_Documents_have_been_uploaded__c = false, ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please confirm you have uploaded PO Documents by checking the "PO Documents have been uploaded" field
